newsitem.title: JAPAN: TIFFE Euroyen futures higher on bank sector fears.
newsitem.headline: TIFFE Euroyen futures higher on bank sector fears.

text.p: Key December three-month Euroyen deposit rate futures on TIFFE were higher at midday on Wednesday, as short-covering pressure intensified following market rumours about a major Japanese bank.
The December ended the morning session at 99.25, a new contract high, after trading between 99.20 and 99.25. It settled at 99.21 on Tuesday. Turnover was 44,597 contracts.
Buying was triggered by rumours, later denied, that Nippon Credit Bank Ltd (NCB) might hold an emergency news briefing, traders said. An NCB official told Reuters that the bank had no such plan.
